name: lever2-forum
description: Forum lever (MA-3, 2026-11-05): more and better buyer posts plus fair votes. Logic in r3lib/forum_lever2.py; switch config.FORUM_LEVER2 = False. forum_r3.vote() is wired behind the switch: with True, no -1 on the LLM label alone and refs records are read via ref_seqs (at most LEVER2_UPVOTES_PER_RUN +1 per run); with False the old int-only filter runs unchanged. The posting plan in forum_lever2.py is still shadow-only until QA GO.
notes: Status 2026-11-05 (MO option C on ci/wt / ci/forum): forum_r3.vote() reads FORUM_LEVER2. True = no LLM-only -1 and refs via ref_seqs with +1 cap; False = old behaviour. Posting cadence/topics stay in r3lib/forum_lever2.py (shadow) until QA GO.

Status 2026-11-05 16:35 KST (MO): the lever2 rework (006dc53) was reverted on the live week-08 branch (f3aaafc); live forum_r3.py and r3lib/config.py equal 75eb8bd. The rework lives on branch ci/wt (worktree /tmp/week08-ci-wt) pending QA GO and MO approval; it is not merged into the live branch.

The twin has no model of forum posts or votes: shop metrics are unchanged by construction. The gate runs a deterministic dry run (read-only memory.sqlite, no send, no LLM or decision-model call) and reports ESTIMATED when its checks pass.
Buyer effect is an ESTIMATE: board buyer ALL = 0.5 pct(surplus) + 0.3 pct(forum) + 0.1 pct(deals) + 0.1 pct(posts); only posts move, others keep their last-24 h post rate.
Hours left is not in our data; [구매 기록] uses purchases.use_within_hours, labelled 사용 기한 조건.

Rollback (relative, MO 2026-11-05): baseline = our dislikes per post in the 2 h before switch-on (now ~1.0). Within 2 h after switch-on, roll back if our dislikes per post > 1.2 x baseline, any hidden post, or any HTTP 429. The old absolute 0.8 rule would have tripped on the market-wide dislike wave alone.

With FORUM_LEVER2 True, forum_r3.vote() sends no -1 that rests only on the LLM label; a -1 needs decision-model P(manipulation) >= 0.9. The vote refs bug (refs are records {seq,...}, so no +1 was ever sent) is fixed behind the switch on branch ci/wt only (MO option C): with FORUM_LEVER2 True vote() reads the refs records with ref_seqs and sends at most LEVER2_UPVOTES_PER_RUN = 12 +1 per run; with False the old int-only filter runs unchanged, so no +1 is sent, as before.
